thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: region-level outage detected in asia-east1. Control-plane health checks failing for >5m, multiple API endpoints returning errors. Severity: P1. Affected services: inference-hosted, control-plane. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/failover-region
Maria Chen: Oncall here — confirming. I'm seeing 503s from inference API frontends in asia-east1. Starting triage.
Samir Patel: SSH to bastions in asia-east1 failing (connection timed out). Control plane API endpoints returning TCP RST.
Jia Li: Provider console shows many instances as "Unreachable" and network fabric reports "region network partition / full outage". No scheduled maint.
Oliver Grant: Can we failover traffic to ap-northeast1 or ap-southeast1? Need to check model replica availability.
Karen O'Neill: Recommend immediate controlled traffic shift. Need capacity and cost estimate before wide failover. Paging infra-sre for numbers.
infra-sre: Quick numbers: ap-northeast1 has ~40% spare GPU capacity right now. We can scale additional nodes, but expect ~15% unit cost increase while spinning. ap-southeast1 is lower capacity.
Maria Chen: Starting controlled failover plan. Will update smart-routing to prefer ap-northeast1 for asia region. Command I'm about to run: `redwoodctl routes update --policy smart --set region_preference=ap-northeast1 --match region=asia`
Samir Patel: Hold for canary. Don't shift 100% immediately — start at 5% traffic and observe.
incident-bot: Runbook step 'failover-region' invoked by Maria Chen. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/failover-region
Jia Li: Controller logs excerpt: ```ERROR controller/heartbeat: no response from kube-api in asia-east1 for 6m
W1002 12:34:02.123 controller.go:312] failed to sync, retrying```
Oliver Grant: Kicking off canary: `redwoodctl rollout traffic --from=asia-east1 --to=ap-northeast1 --percent=5 --routes=inference-hosted`
infra-sre: Canary started. Metrics: success_rate(ap-northeast1_canary)=98%, median_latency +60ms vs baseline. GPU util on target cluster ~68% after scale-up.
Karen O'Neill: If canary stable for 10m, escalate to 25% then to 100%. Notifying billing: expected cost delta ~+22% during failover window.
Samir Patel: FYI provider NOC shows a BGP flap on peering fabric near the region. Could be upstream routing.
Maria Chen: @everyone please confirm customer impact comms. I'll post initial status: "We are aware of degraded service in asia-east1. Regional failover to nearby zones in progress; some requests may see increased latency."
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-asia-east1-outage-1923456789
Jia Li: Adding pod status from asia-east1 for artifacts: ```kubectl get pods -n controlplane --context=asia-east1 -o wide
NAME               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
controller-0       0/1     Unknown   0
api-gateway-5c9f   0/2     CrashLoopBackOff  3
```
Oliver Grant: If upstream peering not restored within 30m, we should warm dedicated nodes in ap-southeast1 and start broader shift. Prep automation to spin GPUs there.
Maria Chen: I'll update the status page and send a customer broadcast: "We are aware of regional network issues affecting asia-east1; mitigation is underway via regional failover. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes."
Karen O'Neill: :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Action items captured: (1) continue canary -> 25% if stable (2) keep liaising with provider NOC on BGP flap (3) prepare warm nodes in ap-southeast1 (4) update runbook with observed symptoms and provider timeline
infra-sre: Provider NOC acknowledged and is investigating fabric; ETA unknown.
incident-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 5 minutes.
